# Cheese Platter

> Cheese Platter ("Tu Cheez Badi Hai Mast Mast") is a free web app that serves 116 cheesy Bollywood pickup lines and filmy dialogues for people going on a date. Press "Find My Cheese" to get a random line, the movie it comes from, and exactly when to use it.

- Audience: women going on a date who want a playful, filmy way to flirt.
- Languages: Hinglish (Hindi in Latin script) and English.
- Every line is listed on the home page under "See the whole platter", grouped by situation: openers, banter, food and the bill, romance, end of the night, and comedy comebacks.
- Lines marked "Tweaked" are playful adaptations of the original dialogue; "Original, inspired by Bollywood" lines are new.
- No sign up, no tracking, no personal data collected.
- Created by Vinita Mathreja: https://www.linkedin.com/in/vinitamathreja/
